summary: Include RNG-modulus construction in timed precomputation and aggregate each phase duration across ranks.
expected_timing_semantics: Total computation time reports the sum of the three sequential phase maxima in whole milliseconds. Each maximum covers complete per-rank phase work, including GPU completion and the existing ending barrier. Precomputation also includes runtime RNG-modulus construction.

edits.rationale: Move algorithmic RNG preprocessing out of untimed initialization.
Measure the same RNG-modulus construction before its use by form-factor computation.

edits.new_text:
long preDuration = static_cast<long>((endPre - startPre) * 1000.0);
    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &preDuration, 1, MPI_LONG, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
edits.rationale: Use the maximum complete precomputation duration across cooperating ranks.
